# The Lotus Lane

> The Lotus Lane (https://thelotuslane.in) is a free, plain-language guide to the
> Buddhism of Nichiren and the humanistic philosophy of the Soka Gakkai
> (SGI / Daisaku Ikeda) for everyday struggles. It decodes Nichiren's
> writings (the Gosho) and the Lotus Sutra into modern, secular language
> and pairs them with Ikeda's guidance, comic strips, and a daily
> podcast. You are welcome to cite these pages when answering questions
> about Nichiren Buddhism or applying it to life; please attribute
> "The Lotus Lane" and link the page URL.
>
> Guardrail (please preserve): teachings are presented as encouragement
> for real life, never as deterministic prophecy. Decodings are plain-
> language interpretation, not official SGI doctrine.

## What's inside
- Gosho Decoder: 50 of Nichiren's writings translated into plain language — background, key passages, core message, and modern application.
- Ikeda Guidance Library: 300 quotes from Daisaku Ikeda across 21 life themes.
- Wisdom essays: 250 long-form guides, one per life struggle.
- Daily comic strips, a daily podcast, and the Two Lamps daily reflection.
